releases.name: v0.2.0 — Per-model thinking levels, daily check-in, wallet credits
releases.body:
## What's changed

### Fixes

- **Errors no longer swallowed into an empty reply.** LobsterAI puts errors inside a 200 SSE stream in two shapes: `event: error` (proxy errors) and a bare `data` record carrying `error` with no event line (upstream errors such as an invalid temperature). Only the first was recognized, so the second was read as a normal stream and turned into a 200 with empty content — the caller had neither a status to fail over on nor the original message. Both shapes now map to real status codes with the vendor's words kept. Mid-stream errors are also caught for non-streaming callers.
- **Kimi sampling parameters cover the whole family.** Measured: `kimi-k3`, `kimi-k3.1-pro` and `kimi-k2.8-preview` all reject a `temperature` other than 1 (`50204 invalid temperature`). The previous rule matched only `kimi-k3*`, so `kimi-k2.8-preview` failed for any client that sends a temperature. The forced `reasoning_effort: max` stays on `kimi-k3` alone, since `kimi-k3.1-pro` honours the full ladder.
- **Desktop-imported accounts check their identity.** magpie keeps several sign-ins per provider, but LobsterAI's desktop app has one signed-in account at a time and the plugin reads its token on every request. Without an identity check, switching the desktop to another account made the imported one quietly spend the other account's credits. The account is now marked *sign in again* instead.
- **Streaming keeps `event:` names**, so a mid-stream error event stays distinguishable from an ordinary chunk.

### Features

- **Thinking levels for the models that have no `thinkingConfig`.** 10 of the 18 usable models report `supportsThinking` but no profile; they accepted `reasoning_effort` while the UI offered no level at all. Levels are declared per model from measurement, because they differ: `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` rejects `none` (*requires adaptive thinking*), `qwen3.7-max` and `qwen3.7-plus` reject `max`, and `MiniMax-M3` writes its thinking into `<think>` tags and grades no effort, so it offers only `none` and `max`. Models that were not measured declare none.
- **Output limit raised from 32,000 to 131,072.** All 18 models accept it, and `glm-5.3` names `[1, 131072]` as its own range.
- **Credits shown as a wallet**, with the soonest-expiring batch (unsOut / unsOutAt), so magpie shows the lapse and routing can spend the account that runs out first. An expired free allowance is no longer shown as a live window.
- **Daily check-in (uth.checkin)**, off by default. It claims LobsterAI's daily gift (100 credits), is idempotent, and re-reads the state before reporting success. This is the only way to collect those credits without opening LobsterAI's desktop app.

## Validation

- `bun test`: **185 passed, 0 failed** (up from 79).
- `bun test --isolate`, and `TZ=UTC --randomize --rerun-each 3`: 549 passed, 0 failed.
- `node --check` on all 25 ESM files.
- 17 end-to-end checks against the live LobsterAI API (error shapes, both thinking channels, Kimi family, daily check-in).
- Verified by installing the published package from npm.

## Not verified

- The check-in's `claimed` path against a real account was not exercised before release (the day was already claimed). It has since run in production and claimed 100 credits.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Jasery/opencode-lobster-auth/compare/v0.1.2...v0.2.0

releases.name: v0.1.2 — Remote browser sign-in
releases.body:
## What's changed

- Added **Remote browser sign-in** for Magpie running on a server, NAS, or in Docker while the browser runs on another machine.
- Exposes the loopback callback address in the login URL's plain query so Magpie can offer its **Callback URL** field, while retaining the portal-required hash parameters.
- Existing browser sign-in and desktop account import remain available.
- Updated the English and Chinese sign-in documentation and added regression coverage.

## Validation

- `bun test`: **79 passed, 0 failed** (189 assertions).
- `git diff --check` passed.

## Thanks

Thanks to @isdoge for contributing #1!

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Jasery/opencode-lobster-auth/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2
